name: AyurRaksha Piles Well Pack
shortDescription: Piles, also known as hemorrhoids, are swollen blood vessels in the rectum and anus, causing discomfort, pain, and sometimes bleeding. There are two main types: internal hemorrhoids, which may bleed and protrude from the anus, and external hemorrhoids, which form under the skin around the anus, leading to itching and irritation. These conditions often result from straining during bowel movements, increased pressure in the anal area, and lifestyle factors such as a diet low in fiber and high in junk food. They are commonly observed in elderly individuals, pregnant women, and those who spend prolonged periods sitting.
